params.rate_desc: Graduated rates: 0% on the first $10,000 of taxable income (one $10,000 band on a joint return), 4.70% above (HB 531). Married combined returns: pass spouse_agi (MFJ only) to apply the schedule to each spouse's column (each gets a $10,000 zero band); the filing-status exemption and standard deduction are split evenly between columns, and dependent exemptions ($1,500 each) go to the taxpayer column. Dependent exemptions are included when dependents is passed.
